blocking_defects.summary: artifact_checks._agent_model_input uses truthy fallback from agent_visible_experiment to treatment_metric_view. Removing agent_visible_experiment or setting it to null, an empty object, or another empty container therefore passes the claimed exact visible binding instead of failing closed for either arm.

artifact_checks._four_blocks only searches for the four required heading substrings and the English text Independent Critic. A fifth H2 block or a four-block Markdown report whose verdict and contents contradict the structured DecisionBrief and FinalVerdict still passes four_block_report and complete.

reproduction.mutation: Set the Single-prompt agent_visible_experiment to an empty object while leaving its bound treatment_metric_view unchanged.

recommended_correction: Require agent_visible_experiment to be present and an exact mapping, never fall back to treatment_metric_view; compare it canonically to view.agent_visible_dict for both arms and add missing, null, empty-object, empty-list, and altered-payload fail-closed tests. Also bind the structured DecisionBrief verdict to FinalVerdict and require the stored Markdown to equal the deterministic four-block renderer output, rejecting extra H2 sections and contradictory or stale content. This is Evidence-only and does not require product model calls or result regeneration.
